name: Immortal Path

passives.name: Slay
passives.effects: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion grants you 0.6% omnivamp, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 6% omnivamp.

passives.name: Now and Forever
passives.effects: While above 50% of your maximum health, you deal 5% increased damage. While below 50% of your maximum health, you gain 15% increased healing, shielding, and health regeneration.
